description: The map of Close Knit's data; call it first, and whenever you are unsure of a metric, path or category name. No arguments: a summary (themes with metric counts and 2-3 headline metrics, Census in one line, places in one line, the entity kinds). theme='crime' lists that theme's metrics: unit, levels, period, coverage (England or London only), better end, what each measures and is not (name the metric you use; say when it differs from the question). query='trees' finds metrics with ranked within, source, own-row levels and England and region refs, paths, place categories and brands by words. kind='place' lists place categories with counts and brands; kind='school' the school measures; kind='lsoa' (or msoa, lad, rgn, pc, uprn, sector) the sections and select paths of that kind; kind='custom' the place presets; kind='ranking' the saved rankings for query(saved:).

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: The callId of the answer you are rating; leave it out when answers carry none.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

kind.description: what to describe: metric (default), place categories, school measures, custom presets, saved rankings, or an entity kind's sections and paths
kind.title: Kind

query.description: words matched against ids, labels, categories, brands and paths
query.title: Query

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried (none: the last answer). Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.
